meta.name: arboreto
meta.description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from gene expression data using scalable algorithms (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Use when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships and regulatory interactions. Supports distributed computation for large-scale datasets.

copy.tagline: 从基因表达数据推断转录因子与靶基因的调控关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要分析RNA-seq数据来发现基因间的调控连接
copy.tagline_en: Infer transcription factor-target gene relationships from gene expression data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to discover regulatory interactions from RNA-seq data

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以调用 arboreto 库，从基因表达数据（如 RNA-seq）中推断基因调控网络，识别转录因子与靶基因之间的调控关系。
howto.when: 当你提供基因表达数据（如单细胞或批量RNA-seq表达矩阵）并请求推断转录因子-靶基因调控网络时触发。

say.text: 请用 arboreto 分析我的单细胞RNA-seq数据，找出转录因子调控关系。
say.note: 会运行 GRNBoost2 算法并返回调控网络。

say.text: 帮我用 GRNBoost2 从表达矩阵推断基因调控网络。
say.note: 直接指定算法，结果以 TSV 格式输出。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can use the arboreto library to infer gene regulatory networks from gene expression data (e.g., RNA-seq), identifying transcription factor-target gene relationships.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you provide gene expression data (e.g., single-cell or bulk RNA-seq matrix) and request inference of transcription factor-target gene regulatory networks.

say_en.text: Infer a gene regulatory network from my expression matrix using GRNBoost2.
say_en.note: Specifies algorithm; output in TSV format.

say_en.text: Perform transcription factor-target gene analysis on bulk RNA-seq data with arboreto.
say_en.note: Supports TF filtering and multi-condition comparisons.
